nurse.text: Hello, welcome to Cambridge Sanctuary! Don't mind the bikes in the porch, they breed.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop them on the counter. We do a very gentle heal, then a cup of tea and a Chelsea bun.
There we are, right as rain. Mind the cyclists on your way out, they do not mind you.
The Ark's in the corner. It was designed by a committee of three colleges, so it took four hundred years.

else.text: No bother at all. Enjoy Cambridge, and keep off the grass. Seriously. There are porters.
